# Public surface of FreexComp.Debugger, hand-copied from the debug-session interface document (sections 2 and 3).
# Compared with a listing generated by reflection (ApiShapeTests). Positional record properties are implied by the
# constructor line. Blank lines and lines starting with a hash sign are ignored; order is not significant.

type IDebugSessionFactory : interface
IDebugSessionFactory.Create(DebugSessionOptions options) : IDebugSession

type DebugSessionOptions : sealed record
DebugSessionOptions..ctor()
DebugSessionOptions.AdapterPath : required string { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.AdapterArguments : IReadOnlyList<string> { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.UserSourceRoots : IReadOnlyList<string> { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.RequestTimeout : TimeSpan { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.LaunchTimeout : TimeSpan { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.ShutdownWaits : ShutdownWaits { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.Trace : Action<DapTraceEntry>? { get; init; }
DebugSessionOptions.Format : ValueFormatOptions { get; init; }

type DapTraceEntry : sealed record
DapTraceEntry..ctor(DateTimeOffset Time, DapDirection Direction, string Json)
type DapDirection : enum = ToAdapter, FromAdapter, AdapterStderr

type ShutdownWaits : sealed record
ShutdownWaits..ctor()
ShutdownWaits.Disconnect : TimeSpan { get; init; }
ShutdownWaits.AdapterExit : TimeSpan { get; init; }
ShutdownWaits.StderrEnd : TimeSpan { get; init; }
ShutdownWaits.TerminalClose : TimeSpan { get; init; }

type ValueFormatOptions : sealed record
ValueFormatOptions..ctor()
ValueFormatOptions.HexIntegers : bool { get; init; }
ValueFormatOptions.MaxStringChars : int { get; init; }
ValueFormatOptions.MaxSummaryElements : int { get; init; }
ValueFormatOptions.ChildPageSize : int { get; init; }
ValueFormatOptions.UseVisualizers : bool { get; init; }
ValueFormatOptions.VisualizerTimeout : TimeSpan { get; init; }

type LaunchRequest : sealed record
LaunchRequest..ctor()
LaunchRequest.Program : required string { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.Arguments : IReadOnlyList<string> { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.WorkingDirectory : string? { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.Environment : IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.StopOnEntry : bool { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.StopAtMainBody : bool { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.Breakpoints : IReadOnlyList<SourceBreakpoints> { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.Exceptions : ExceptionSettings { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.TypeInfoPath : string? { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.Libraries : IReadOnlyList<string> { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.Terminal : IDebuggeeTerminal? { get; init; }
LaunchRequest.InputAtEnd : bool { get; init; }

type DebugState : enum = Idle, Starting, Running, Stopped, Terminating, Terminated
type StopReason : enum = Entry, Breakpoint, Step, Pause, Exception, RunToLine

type StopInfo : sealed record
StopInfo..ctor(int Epoch, StopReason Reason, int ThreadId, SourceLocation? Location, IReadOnlyList<int> HitBreakpointIds, ExceptionInfo? Exception, string Description)

type SourceLocation : sealed record
SourceLocation..ctor(string Path, int Line, int Column)

type ExceptionKind : enum = Language, Os
type ExceptionInfo : sealed record
ExceptionInfo..ctor(ExceptionKind Kind, string ClassName, string Message, uint OsCode, ulong ObjectAddress)

type ExceptionSettings : sealed record
ExceptionSettings..ctor()
ExceptionSettings.BreakOnLanguageExceptions : bool { get; init; }
ExceptionSettings.BreakOnOsExceptions : bool { get; init; }
ExceptionSettings.IgnoredClasses : IReadOnlyList<string> { get; init; }

type SourceBreakpoints : sealed record
SourceBreakpoints..ctor(string Path, IReadOnlyList<BreakpointSpec> Breakpoints)

type BreakpointSpec : sealed record
BreakpointSpec..ctor()
BreakpointSpec.Id : required int { get; init; }
BreakpointSpec.Line : required int { get; init; }
BreakpointSpec.Enabled : bool { get; init; }
BreakpointSpec.Condition : string? { get; init; }
BreakpointSpec.HitCount : HitCountSpec? { get; init; }
BreakpointSpec.LogMessage : string? { get; init; }
type HitCountMode : enum = Equal, GreaterOrEqual, Multiple
type HitCountSpec : sealed record
HitCountSpec..ctor(HitCountMode Mode, int Value)

type BreakpointState : enum = Pending, Verified, Invalid, Disabled
type BreakpointStatus : sealed record
BreakpointStatus..ctor(int Id, BreakpointState State, int ActualLine, int HitCount, string? Message)

type ThreadInfo : sealed record
ThreadInfo..ctor(int Id, string Name, bool IsCurrent)

type StackFrameInfo : sealed record
StackFrameInfo..ctor(int Id, int Index, string Name, SourceLocation? Location, bool IsUserCode, ulong InstructionPointer, string Module)

type StackTraceResult : sealed record
StackTraceResult..ctor(IReadOnlyList<StackFrameInfo> Frames, int TotalFrames)

type ScopeKind : enum = Arguments, Locals, Globals
type VariableScope : sealed record
VariableScope..ctor(ScopeKind Kind, string Name, VariableHandle Handle)

type VariableHandle : readonly record struct
VariableHandle..ctor(int Epoch, int Id)

type ValueKind : enum = Integer, Float, Boolean, Char, Enum, Set, String, StaticArray, DynamicArray, Record, ClassInstance, ClassReference, Pointer, Interface, Procedural, Raw, Error

type VariableInfo : sealed record
VariableInfo..ctor(string Name, string Value, string TypeName, ValueKind Kind, VariableHandle? Children, int ChildCount, bool CanModify, string? EvaluateName, ulong? Address)
VariableInfo.Text : VariableHandle? { get; init; }

type TextKind : enum = Unicode, Ansi, Short, PChar, PAnsiChar, CharArray, Computed
type TextDetails : sealed record
TextDetails..ctor(TextKind Kind, long Length, int? RefCount, int? CodePage, string Encoding, int ElementSize, ulong? PayloadAddress, int? MaxLength)
type TextChunk : sealed record
TextChunk..ctor(long Start, long Next, string Text, bool AtEnd, bool Truncated)

type EvaluateContext : enum = Watch, Hover, Console
type EvaluateResult : sealed record
EvaluateResult..ctor(VariableInfo Value)

type OutputCategory : enum = Stdout, Stderr, Debugger, LogPoint
type OutputEventArgs : sealed record
OutputEventArgs..ctor(OutputCategory Category, string Text)

type StateChangedEventArgs : sealed record
StateChangedEventArgs..ctor(DebugState OldState, DebugState NewState)
type BreakpointChangedEventArgs : sealed record
BreakpointChangedEventArgs..ctor(BreakpointStatus Status)
type ThreadChange : enum = Started, Exited
type ThreadChangedEventArgs : sealed record
ThreadChangedEventArgs..ctor(int ThreadId, ThreadChange Change)
type ModuleEventArgs : sealed record
ModuleEventArgs..ctor(string Name, string Path, bool HasSymbols)
type TerminationCause : enum = Exited, TerminatedByUser, AdapterCrashed, LaunchFailed, Disposed
type TerminatedEventArgs : sealed record
TerminatedEventArgs..ctor(TerminationCause Cause, int? ExitCode, string? Message)

type DebugErrorCode : enum = AdapterNotFound, AdapterStartFailed, AdapterCrashed, ProtocolError, MissingCapability, RequestTimeout, RequestFailed, InvalidState, StaleReference, ProgramNotFound, LaunchFailed, TypeInfoMissing, TypeInfoInvalid, ExpressionSyntax, ExpressionEvaluation, MemoryUnreadable, NotModifiable, Cancelled

type DebuggerException : sealed class, Exception
DebuggerException..ctor(DebugErrorCode code, string message, string? dapCommand = null, Exception? inner = null)
DebuggerException.Code : DebugErrorCode { get; }
DebuggerException.DapCommand : string? { get; }

type IDebugSession : interface, IAsyncDisposable
IDebugSession.State : DebugState { get; }
IDebugSession.CurrentStop : StopInfo? { get; }
IDebugSession.ProcessId : int? { get; }
IDebugSession.ExitCode : int? { get; }
IDebugSession.HasTypeInfo : bool { get; }
IDebugSession.LaunchAsync(LaunchRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.TerminateAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.ContinueAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.PauseAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.StepOverAsync(int threadId, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.StepIntoAsync(int threadId, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.StepOutAsync(int threadId, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.RunToLineAsync(string path, int line, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.SetBreakpointsAsync(string path, IReadOnlyList<BreakpointSpec> breakpoints, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<IReadOnlyList<BreakpointStatus>>
IDebugSession.SetExceptionSettingsAsync(ExceptionSettings settings, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
IDebugSession.GetThreadsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<IReadOnlyList<ThreadInfo>>
IDebugSession.GetStackTraceAsync(int threadId, int startFrame = 0, int maxFrames = 200, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<StackTraceResult>
IDebugSession.GetScopesAsync(int frameId, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<IReadOnlyList<VariableScope>>
IDebugSession.GetChildrenAsync(VariableHandle handle, int start = 0, int count = 0, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<IReadOnlyList<VariableInfo>>
IDebugSession.EvaluateAsync(string expression, int? frameId, EvaluateContext context, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<EvaluateResult>
IDebugSession.SetValueAsync(string evaluateName, string valueExpression, int? frameId, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<VariableInfo>
IDebugSession.ReadMemoryAsync(ulong address, int count, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<byte[]>
IDebugSession.GetTextDetailsAsync(VariableHandle text, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<TextDetails>
IDebugSession.ReadTextAsync(VariableHandle text, long start, int count, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<TextChunk>
event IDebugSession.StateChanged : EventHandler<StateChangedEventArgs>?
event IDebugSession.Stopped : EventHandler<StopInfo>?
event IDebugSession.Continued : EventHandler?
event IDebugSession.Output : EventHandler<OutputEventArgs>?
event IDebugSession.BreakpointChanged : EventHandler<BreakpointChangedEventArgs>?
event IDebugSession.ThreadChanged : EventHandler<ThreadChangedEventArgs>?
event IDebugSession.ModuleLoaded : EventHandler<ModuleEventArgs>?
event IDebugSession.Terminated : EventHandler<TerminatedEventArgs>?

type DebugSessionFactory : sealed class, IDebugSessionFactory
DebugSessionFactory..ctor()
DebugSessionFactory.Create(DebugSessionOptions options) : IDebugSession

type IDebuggeeTerminal : interface
IDebuggeeTerminal.StartAsync(DebuggeeTerminalRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task<IDebuggeeTerminalRun>

type DebuggeeTerminalRequest : sealed record
DebuggeeTerminalRequest..ctor(IReadOnlyList<string> Command, string WorkingDirectory, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?>? Environment, string Title)

type IDebuggeeTerminalRun : interface
IDebuggeeTerminalRun.ProcessId : int { get; }
IDebuggeeTerminalRun.Ended : Task<int?> { get; }
IDebuggeeTerminalRun.CloseAsync(bool keepWindow, CancellationToken ct = default) : Task
